source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Make a copy for yourself. 
3. Use the [editable forms system](https://www.nsw.gov.au/family-and-community/crime-and-justice/fire-safety/safety#editable-forms) to look up your records. 
4. Save your document as a PDF.
5. Use the PDF tool available in your computer, smartphone, or tablet to sign the form or attach a signature image.
6. Send it back to

***NSW Fire and Rescue Community Safety***

[Primary Contact Page](https://fire.nsw.gov.au/about-us/contact-us)

> 22 Townsend Street, MARRICKVILLE NSW 2204
> P02 8741 5692 | F02 8741 8125
> PO BOX 1407, WELCOME
